mapper.select: SELECT member_Id, password, nickname, email, profile_image, phone_number, birthDate, gender FROM member_tb ORDER BY member_Id
mapper.update: update member_tb set password=#{password}, nickname=#{nickname}, email=#{email} ,profile_image = #{profile_image} ,phone_number=#{phone_number} , birthDate = #{birthDate},gender=#{gender} where member_Id=#{member_Id}
